## Overview

This Adapter Validation Suite (AVS) instantiates the [UIAO_121 Adapter Conformance Test Plan](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/blob/main/src/uiao/canon/specs/adapter-conformance-test-plan-template.md) for the `entra-workload-identity` adapter. It defines the Tier-1 contract-conformance criteria, the controls under validation, and the integration test plan that govern the adapter across its lifecycle.

## Validation status

**Reserved slot — not yet implemented.** `entra-workload-identity` is `status: reserved` / `phase: phase-planning` in canon. No adapter code exists yet. The Tier-1 criteria below define the conformance gate the adapter **must** clear at activation; they are a forward-looking plan, not a current result.

## Scope

Target surfaces / subsystems: `workload-identity-federation`, `app-credentials`, `managed-identity-assignments`, `credential-hygiene`

**Validation artifacts:** `workload-identity-manifest.json`, `credential-rotation-audit.json`

The suite validates that, for each target surface, the adapter normalizes vendor data into canonical claims, emits deterministic provenance, and produces KSI-anchored evidence — without mutating any source system (`ssot-mutation: never`).

## Controls under validation

The control roles below are mirrored from the adapter's companion [Adapter Technical Specification](../../../adapter-specs/entra-workload-identity/entra-workload-identity.html); the validation suite verifies that the adapter produces the evidence each role asserts.

NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls this adapter supports: `IA-5`, `IA-5(1)`, `IA-5(2)`, `IA-9`, `AC-2`

| Control | Role | Adapter capability |
|---|---|---|
| **IA-5** Authenticator Management | Primary | Provisions and rotates workload authenticators (federation trusts, managed identities, client secrets, certificates) per the canon-defined lifecycle. |
| **IA-5(1)** Password-Based Authentication | Primary | Federation trusts and managed identities replace password-based service-account authentication entirely; client-secret rotation is the fallback path. |
| **IA-5(2)** PKI-Based Authentication | Supporting | Certificate-based workload credentials are issued and rotated through the documented PKI integration; certificate thumbprints are tracked in the manifest. |
| **IA-9** Service Identification and Authentication | Primary | Every workload identity is registered with a stable identifier and federated authentication contract — no anonymous service principals. |
| **AC-2** Account Management | Supporting | Workload identity inventory feeds the broader account-management view alongside [`entra-id`](../entra-id/entra-id.html) user / group inventory. |
